18182.name: Improved Life Tap
18182.description: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by $s1%.

45913.name: Improved Drains
45913.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Drain Soul, Drain Life and Drain Mana by $s1%.

18827.name: Improved Curse of Agony
18827.description: Increases the damage done by your Curse of Agony by $s1%.

17783.name: Fel Concentration
17783.description: Gives your Affliction spells a $s1% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

18223.name: Curse of Exhaustion
18223.description: Reduces the target's movement speed by $s1% for $d.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

18218.name: Grim Reach
18218.description: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by $s1%.

18094.name: Nightfall
18094.description: Gives your Corruption, Dark Harvest and Drain spells a $h% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance state after damaging the opponent.  The Shadow Trance state reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by -100% and makes it guaranteed to land.

52558.name: Soul Siphon
52558.description: Increases the damage of your Drain Soul, Dark Harvest and Death Coil by an additional $s1% for each of your Affliction effects on the target, up to a maximum of 4 effects.

52555.name: Rapid Deterioration
52555.description: Increases the casting speed of your Affliction spells by $s1%.  In addition, casting speed increase effects increase the tick speed of your damage over time and channeled Affliction spells with 50% efficiency, reducing their duration.

18265.name: Siphon Life
18265.description: Transfers $*10;s1 Health from the target to the caster over $d.

18310.name: Improved Curse of Exhaustion
18310.description: Increases the speed reduction of your Curse of Exhaustion by $s1%.

52546.name: Malediction
52546.description:
Your Curse of Agony can be used alongside your other curses, except Curse of Doom.

Applying Curse of Recklessness, Curse of Shadows, or Curse of Elements also afflicts the target with the highest rank of your Curse of Agony.

18271.name: Shadow Mastery
18271.description: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by $s1%.

52550.name: Dark Harvest
52550.description: Reaps the target's life, dealing $*8;s1 Shadow damage over $d. While channeling, the time between periodic ticks of your Affliction spells on the target is reduced by $s2%. If the target dies while channeling, the cooldown of Dark Harvest is reset.

52737.name: Sinister Pursuit
52737.description: Increases the movement speed of your demons by $s1%.

18697.name: Demonic Embrace
18697.description: Increases your total Stamina by $s1% but reduces your total Spirit by $s2%.

51706.name: Soul Entrapment
51706.description: While you have no demon under your control, all damage dealt is increased by $s1%.

18703.name: Soul Funnel
18703.description: Increases the amount of Health transferred by your Health Funnel by $s1% of your demon's missing Health and the Mana transferred by your Mana Funnel by $s1% of your demon's missing Mana. This additional transfer drains $q1% of that amount from you.

45921.name: Demonic Aegis
45921.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Armor spell by $s1%.

18731.name: Fel Intellect
18731.description: Increases your demon's Intellect by $s1% of your total Intellect and allows $s2% of its Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

18708.name: Fel Domination
18708.description: Your next Common demon summoning spell has its casting time reduced by $/1000;S1 sec and its Mana cost reduced by $s2%.

18748.name: Fel Stamina
18748.description: Increases your demon's Stamina by $s1% of your total Stamina and reduces its chance to be critically struck by $s2%.

18788.name: Demonic Sacrifice
18788.description:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned demon to grant you an effect. The effect is canceled if any demon is summoned or enslaved.

Imp: Increases spell damage done by 4%.

Voidwalker: Restores 3% of total Health every  sec.

Succubus: Reduces threat generated by -10%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of total Mana every  sec.

51712.name: Improved Stones
51712.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Felstone, Wrathstone, Voidstone, and Spellstone by $s1%, and increases the critical strike chance bonus of your Firestone by $s2%.

18709.name: Master Summoner
18709.description: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, and Felhunter summoning spells by $/1000;s1 sec and their mana cost by $s2%. In addition, reduces the cooldown of Inferno, Ritual of Doom, and Demon Gate by $s3%.

51709.name: Nether Studies
51709.description: Increases the effect of your Succubus' Seduction, your Voidwalker's Torment, your Imp's Blood Pact, and your Felhunter's Tainted Blood spells by $s1%.

18769.name: Unholy Power
18769.description: Increases the damage done by your demons by $s1%.

51714.name: Power Overwhelming
51714.description: Channel energy into your demon, breaking all crowd control effects and increasing its damage dealt by $s2% for $d. The demon takes $o3% of its base health as damage over the duration.

51715.name: Demonic Precision
51715.description: Your demons gain 1% increased chance to hit and critically strike, and they also inherit $s1% of your spell hit and crit chance as melee and spell hit and crit chance, respectively.

23785.name: Master Demonologist
23785.description:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Reduces spell costs by -3%.

Voidwalker - Reduces physical damage taken by -2%.

Succubus - Increases all damage done by 2%.

Felhunter - Increases all resistances by 0.

Greater Demons - Increases spell critical strike chance by 2%.

51721.name: Unleashed Potential
51721.description: Your direct damage spell hits allow your demon to benefit from 5% of your Fire and Shadow spell bonus damage for 20 sec. Each tick of your funnel spells refreshes its duration. Stacks up to  times.

19028.name: Soul Link
19028.description: While a demon is under your control, the damage dealt by you and your demon is increased by 5%. In addition, 20% of all damage you take is taken by your demon.  Your Greater and Enslaved Demons can no longer break free from your control early.

17793.name: Shadow Vulnerability
17793.description: Your Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul have a $h% chance to increase Shadow damage dealt to the target by 20% for 10 sec, with a higher chance to trigger on critical hits.

17778.name: Cataclysm
17778.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by $s1%.

57730.name: Demonic Swiftness
57730.description: Reduces the casting time of your Imp's Firebolt spell by $/1000;S2 sec and reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' Lash of Pain spell by $/1000;s1 sec.

17788.name: Bane
17788.description: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Searing Pain, and Immolate spells by $/1000;S1 sec and your Soul Fire spell by $/1000;S2 sec.

18119.name: Aftermath
18119.description: Increases the periodic damage of your Immolate spell by $s2% and gives your Destruction spells a $h% chance to slow the target by 50% for 5 sec.

18135.name: Intensity
18135.description: Gives your Fire spells a $s1% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

17877.name: Shadowburn
17877.description: Instantly blasts the target for $s2 Shadow damage.  If the target dies within $d of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

18130.name: Devastation
18130.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by $s1%.

18096.name: Pyroclasm
18096.description: Gives your Rain of Fire, Hellfire, Conflagrate, and Soul Fire spells a 13% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

17917.name: Destructive Reach
17917.description: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by $s1% and the radius of your Hellfire by $s2%.

17927.name: Improved Searing Pain
17927.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by $s1%.

51736.name: Improved Soul Fire
51736.description: Your Soul Fire has a $h% chance to refund a Soul Shard and increase your Fire damage by 10% for 30 sec.

17815.name: Improved Immolate
17815.description: Increases the damage of your Immolate spell by $s1%.

17959.name: Ruin
17959.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by $s1%.

17954.name: Emberstorm
17954.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by $s1%.

17962.name: Conflagrate
17962.description: Ignites the target, dealing $s1 Fire damage and consuming 3 sec of your Immolate spell to deal an amount of damage equal to it.

19552.name: Swift Aspects
19552.description: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, all normal ranged attacks have a $h% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 3% for 12 sec.  While Aspect of the Wolf is active, all normal melee attacks have a $h% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 3% for 12 sec.

19583.name: Endurance Training
19583.description: Adds $s2% of your Stamina to your pets' Stamina and increases their health by $s1%.

19557.name: Improved Eyes of the Beast
19557.description:
Increases the duration of your Eyes of the Beast by $/1000;s1 sec.

While channeling Eyes of the Beast, your pet deals 16% additional damage and gains 16% increased Focus regeneration.

19549.name: Improved Primal Aspects
19549.description: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by $s1%. While Aspect of the Wolf is active, you're healed for $s2% of your melee damage.

19609.name: Thick Hide
19609.description: Adds $s2% of your armor value from items to the armor value of your pets and increases the armor value of your pets by $s1%.

24443.name: Improved Revive Pet
24443.description: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by $/1000;s1 sec, mana cost is reduced by $s2%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional $s3%.

19559.name: Pathfinding
19559.description: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by $s1% and increases your pet's movement speed by $s2%.

49559.name: Coordinated Assault
49559.description: Hitting an enemy with Arcane Shot, Steady Shot, or Raptor Strike causes your pet's next attack within 6 sec to also strike for Physical damage equal to 20% of your Attack Power. This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

19616.name: Unleashed Fury
19616.description: Increases the damage done by your pets by $s1%.

19590.name: Bestial Discipline
19590.description: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 2 each tick and reduces the cooldown of your pets' special ability by $s2%.

19572.name: Improved Mend Pet
19572.description: Increases amount you heal your pet with Mend Pet by $s2% and gives the spell a $s1% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic or Poison effect from the pet each tick.

19598.name: Ferocity
19598.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets by $s1%.

52994.name: Scent of Blood
52994.description: Your attacks have a $h% chance to send your pet into a rage, causing it to deal 40% additional damage for 8 sec.

19574.name: Bestial Wrath
19574.description: Sends your pet into a rage, granting it Scent of Blood for $d. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity, remorse, or fear, and cannot be stopped except by death.

19577.name: Intimidation
19577.description: Command your pet to intimidate the target on the next successful melee attack, stunning the target for 3 sec, and increasing the pet's threat generation by 50% for 8 sec.

51554.name: Bestial Precision
51554.description: Increases the physical hit chance of your pets by $s1% and the spell hit chance of your pets by $s2%. In addition, increases the weapon skill of your pets by 5.

19578.name: Spirit Bond
19578.description: Your pet gains melee attack power equal to $s2% of your ranged attack power and spell power equal to $s3% of your ranged attack power. While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every  sec.

19621.name: Frenzy
19621.description: Gives your pet a $s1% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

41827.name: Kill Command
41827.description: Commands your pet to instantly attack for 80% of its Attack Power. Can only be used after the Hunter lands a critical strike on the target.

19407.name: Improved Concussive Shot
19407.description: Gives your Concussive Shot a $h% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

19416.name: Efficiency
19416.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots and Stings by $s1%.

19464.name: Improved Stings
19464.description: Increases the damage of Serpent Sting by $s1%, increases the mana drained by Viper Sting by $s2%, and causes Scorpid Sting to reduce attack speed by an additional $s3%.

19426.name: Lethal Shots
19426.description: Increases your critical strike chance with ranged weapons by $s1%.

19498.name: Hawk Eye
19498.description: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by $s1 yards.

19434.name: Aimed Shot
19434.description: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by $s1.

19454.name: Swiftshot
19454.description: Reduces the cooldown of Arcane Shot by $/1000;S1 sec and the cooldown of Aimed Shot by $/1000;S2 sec.

51517.name: Endless Quiver
51517.description: Your Auto Shot, Arcane Shot, Steady Shot and Multi-Shot have a $h% chance to fire an additional normal ranged attack.  This additional shot does not spend ammo.

19485.name: Mortal Shots
19485.description: Increases your ranged weapon critical strike damage bonus by $s1%.

19503.name: Scatter Shot
19503.description: A short-range shot that deals $s1% weapon damage and disorients the target for $d.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.  Turns off your attack when used.

58108.name: Experimental Ammunition
58108.description:
Your Aimed Shot deals an additional $s1% of its damage as Fire, Arcane, or Nature damage, based on the active effect. Grants a further benefit depending on the element:
- Explosive Ammunition: Your next Multi-Shot causes hits to explode, dealing 20% ranged weapon damage to enemies within  yards of the targets.
- Poisonous Ammunition: Your next Serpent Sting deals 100% increased damage and applies a corrosive poison that reduces the target's armor by 0 for 15 sec.
- Enchanted Ammunition: Your next Arcane Shot deals 100% increased damage and weakens the target's resistance to magic, increasing magic damage taken by 3% for 6 sec.

51512.name: Piercing Shots
51512.description: Your critical strikes from Multi-Shot, Steady Shot and Aimed Shot cause the target to bleed, dealing $s1% of the damage over 8 sec.  This damage generates no threat.

19461.name: Barrage
19461.description: Increases the damage of Multi-Shot and Volley by $s1% and reduces the cast time of Volley by $/1000;m3 sec.

51515.name: Improved Marksmanship
51515.description: Increases the damage of Steady Shot and Aimed Shot by $s1%.

19507.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
19507.description: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by $s1%.

52920.name: Lock and Load
52920.description: Your Steady Shot, Aimed Shot, and Arcane Shot critical strikes have a $h% chance to reset the cooldown of Aimed Shot and trigger Lock and Load. Lock and Load reduces the cast time of Aimed Shot by -1 sec and causes Aimed Shot to hit all enemies between you and the target. Lasts 10 sec or until Aimed Shot is cast.

45977.name: Improved Slaying
45977.description: Increases all damage caused against Beasts, Giants, Dragonkin, and Humanoid targets by $s1% and increases critical damage caused against Beasts, Giants, Dragonkin, and Humanoid targets by an additional $s2%.

51570.name: Resourcefulness
51570.description: Reduces the Mana cost of all traps and melee abilities by $s1%.

19295.name: Swift Reflexes
19295.description: Increases your Parry chance and attack speed by $s1%.

19184.name: Entrapment
19184.description: Gives your Immolation Trap, Frost Trap, and Explosive Trap a $h% chance to entrap the target, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

19159.name: Savage Strikes
19159.description: Increases the damage done by your offhand weapon by $s2% and the critical strike chance of your Lacerate, Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite, Carve and Wing Clip abilities by $s1%.

19228.name: Improved Wing Clip
19228.description: Gives your Wing Clip ability a $h% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

52891.name: Alone Against the World
52891.description: While you have no pet under your control, all damage dealt is increased by $s1%.

51576.name: Planning Ahead
51576.description: The duration of Freezing and Frost Trap effects and the damage of Immolation and Explosive Trap effects are increased by $s1% if the traps are not triggered within the first 5 sec after being placed.

51575.name: Carve
51575.description:
A sweeping attack that strikes up to $i1 enemies in a $a1 yard cone in front of you, dealing $s1% weapon damage.
This ability shares a cooldown with Multi-Shot.

19263.name: Deterrence
19263.description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by $s1% for $d.

51579.name: Stinging Nettle
51579.description: Your Mongoose Bite and triggered Fire traps now apply your highest rank of Serpent Sting for $s1% of the duration. Serpent Stings applied this way ignore resistances and immunities.

19290.name: Surefooted
19290.description:
Increases hit chance by $s3%, and by an additional $s3% while dual wielding.
In addition, increases the chance to resist movement impairing effects by $s1%.

19286.name: Improved Feign Death
19286.description: Reduces the chance your Feign Death ability will be resisted by $s1%.

19370.name: Killer Instinct
19370.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by $s1%, increases your melee critical strike damage bonus by $s2%.

19376.name: Trap Mastery
19376.description: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost Trap effects by $s2% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive Trap effects by $s3%.  In addition, reduces the chance that enemies will resist trap effects by $s1%.

48049.name: Lacerate
48049.description: Deepens the target's open wound, dealing damage equal to $s1% of melee Attack Power and causing the target to bleed for 20% of that damage over 8 sec. Can only be used after critically striking the target. Using this ability from the target's sides increases its damage by 15%.

51584.name: Vicious Strikes
51584.description: Reduces the cooldown of Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite by $/1000;m1 sec and increases the damage they deal by $s2%.

19168.name: Lightning Reflexes
19168.description: Increases your Agility by $s1% and increases your melee attack power by an amount equal to $s2% of your Agility.

51586.name: Untamed Trapper
51586.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Immolation Trap and Explosive Trap effects by $s2% and increases their damage based on your melee Attack Power. In addition, all traps can be placed while in combat.

51304.name: Holy Judgement
51304.description: Casting Judgement reduces the casting time of your next Holy Light by 0 sec.

20205.name: Spiritual Focus
20205.description: Gives your Flash of Light and Holy Light spells a $s1% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

20224.name: Improved Seal of Righteousness
20224.description: Increases the damage done by your Seal of Righteousness and Judgement of Righteousness by $s1%.

20237.name: Healing Light
20237.description: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock spells by $s1%.

20218.name: Sanctity Aura
20218.description: Increases Holy damage done by party members within $a1 yards by $s1%.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

20234.name: Improved Lay on Hands
20234.description: Gives the target of your Lay on Hands spell a 15% bonus to their armor value from items for 120 sec.  In addition, the cooldown for your Lay on Hands spell is reduced by $/60000;s2 min.

9453.name: Unyielding Faith
9453.description: Increases your chance to resist Fear and Disorient effects by an additional $s1%.

20254.name: Improved Concentration Aura
20254.description: Increases the effect of your Concentration Aura by an additional $s1% and gives all group members affected by the aura an additional $s1% chance to resist Silence and Interrupt effects.

20210.name: Illumination
20210.description: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock heal spell, you regain Mana equal to $s1% of the base cost of the spell.

51310.name: Ironclad
51310.description: Increases healing done by spells and effects by up to $s1% of your Armor from items.

51312.name: Divine Favor
51312.description: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with Holy Shock by $s1%.

20473.name: Holy Shock
20473.description: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 97 to 104 Holy damage to an enemy, or 311 to 320 healing to an ally. Casting Holy Shock has a chance to have no cooldown for its next cast.

5923.name: Holy Power
5923.description: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy Light and Flash of Light by $s1%.

51317.name: Blessed Strikes
51317.description: Crusader Strike has a $h% chance to reset the cooldown of your Holy Shock.  In addition, the healing effect of your Holy Strike is increased by $s3% and benefits from an additional $s2% of your healing power.

51323.name: Daybreak
51323.description: Critically healing an ally applies Daybreak for 30 sec. When the ally takes damage, Daybreak is consumed to heal them for 248 to 289.

20138.name: Improved Devotion Aura
20138.description: Increases the armor bonus of your Devotion Aura by $s1%.

45818.name: Redoubt
45818.description: Successful melee and ranged attacks against you have a $h% chance to increase your chance to block by 3%. Lasts 10 sec or  blocks.

20189.name: Precision
20189.description: Increases your chance to hit with melee attacks and spells by $s1%.

20174.name: Guardian's Favor
20174.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Hand of Protection by $/1000;s1 sec and increases the duration of your Hand of Freedom by $/1000;s2 sec.

20143.name: Toughness
20143.description: Increases your armor value from items by $s1%.

20468.name: Improved Righteous Fury
20468.description: Increases the amount of threat generated by your Righteous Fury spell by $s1%.

20911.name: Blessing of Sanctuary
20911.description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, reducing damage taken from all sources by up to $s1 for $d.  In addition, when the target blocks a melee attack, the attacker takes $s2 Holy damage.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

20148.name: Shield Specialization
20148.description: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by $s1% and has a $h% chance to restore 2% of maximum mana when a block occurs. This effect cannot occur more than once every 5 sec.

51334.name: Improved Hand of Reckoning
51334.description: Improves your chance to hit with Hand of Reckoning by $s1%.

20487.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
20487.description: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by $/1000;s1 sec.

51328.name: Righteous Defense
51328.description: While Righteous Fury is active, your damage taken is reduced by -3%.

20925.name: Holy Shield
20925.description: Increases chance to block by $s1% for $d. While active, each blocked attack deals $s2 Holy damage to the attacker.  Damage caused by Holy Shield generates 50% additional threat.  Each block expends a charge.  $n charges.

45823.name: Reckoning
45823.description: Gives you a $h% chance after blocking an attack to generate an additional attack.

51341.name: Righteous Strikes
51341.description: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike by $s2% and its damage by $s3%. In addition, Crusader Strike grants Zealous Defense, causing the next successful block to prevent an additional -6% of the attack's damage.

51346.name: Bulwark of the Righteous
51346.description: Bash the target with your shield, dealing $s1 Holy damage and reducing the damage you take by $s2% for $d.

20042.name: Improved Blessings
20042.description: Increases the effectiveness your Blessing of Might and Wisdom by $s1%.

20101.name: Benediction
20101.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Judgement and Seal spells by $s1%.

25956.name: Improved Judgement
25956.description: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement spell by $/1000;s1 sec.

20335.name: Improved Seal of the Crusader
20335.description: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Seal of the Crusader and the Holy damage increase of your Judgement of the Crusader by $s1%.

20091.name: Improved Retribution Aura
20091.description: Increases the damage done by your Retribution Aura by $s1%.

20117.name: Conviction
20117.description: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with melee weapons by $s1%.

20217.name: Blessing of Kings
20217.description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by $s1% for $d.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

26022.name: Pursuit of Justice
26022.description: Increases movement and mounted movement speed by $s1%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

20111.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
20111.description: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by $s1%, and your weapon skill with two-handed swords, maces and axes by 1.

9452.name: Vindication
9452.description: Gives the Paladin's damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's damage dealt by -3% for 10 sec. Only affects targets of level  or lower.

9799.name: Eye for an Eye
9799.description: All spell criticals against you cause $s1% of the damage taken to the caster as well.  The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

20049.name: Vengeance
20049.description: Gives you a 1% bonus to all damage you deal and decreases threat you generate by -2% for 30 sec after dealing a critical strike from a weapon swing, spell, or ability. This effect stacks up to 3 times. Threat reduction does not apply if the Paladin is under the effect of Righteous Fury.

20375.name: Seal of Command
20375.description:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of melee damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.  Lasts $d.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 47 Holy damage, 93 to 101 if the target is stunned or incapacitated. This damage is increased by 15% of your attack power.

51355.name: Vengeful Strikes
51355.description: Crusader Strike deals an additional $s2% damage and Zeal increases your attack and casting speed by an additional $s3% per stack.Holy Strike infuses you with Holy Might, increasing your Strength by 4% for 20 sec.

20066.name: Repentance
20066.description:
Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to $d.  Any damage caused will awaken the target.

If the target is immune to the effect, they repent for their sins, taking 80 Holy damage each time they perform a melee attack for 20 sec.
